runtimeJs.name: web-llm-0.2.84-qwen-m5-lookahead.js
runtimeJs.role: Hash-verified WebLLM ESM runtime with K-step decode, WebGPU runtime-overlap flags, and GPU lookahead; reused without duplication from the 1.7B catalog artifact. Lookahead is disabled for this entry (runtime.config.lookahead=0); it was measured for this model and not adopted (1.032x, IQR crossing parity).

modelWasm.name: qwen3.5-0.8b-argmax-chunk256-sg32.wasm
modelWasm.role: Qwen3.5-0.8B model library with subgroup-32 and chunk-256 two-stage full-vocabulary GPU argmax. WebGPU GEMV TR is a no-op for this model (byte-identical compiled output at every TR value), so no TR is named in the filename.

modelResources.name: mlc-ai/Qwen3.5-0.8B-q4f16_1-MLC snapshot
modelResources.role: Immutable upstream weights, tokenizer and MLC chat configuration

notes: The runtime JS is reused by immutable URL and hash rather than uploaded again: it is byte-identical to the bundle already published for the Qwen3-1.7B lookahead entry (confirmed by SHA-256 before reuse). The new model WASM and multi-file upstream model repository are independently revision-pinned and byte-hashed where applicable.
